cats.name: Catizen
cats.whoIsTheCat: No single real cat. The Catizens are the cartoon cast of Catizen, a Telegram mini-game made by Pluto Studio (co-founders David Mak and Ricky Wong) that opened in March 2024. Players run a cat café and swipe matching cats together to level them up. It went viral on Telegram in mid-2024; the mascot art shows orange-and-cream, brown tabby and grey-and-white cartoon cats.

virality.summary: Catizen spread through Telegram itself: a cat-café mini app with no install, shared by referral inside chats and boosted by TON's Open League campaigns. On July 23, 2024 Telegram founder Pavel Durov, calling himself 'clearly a dog person', told his channel that Catizen was 'the largest cat-lover community in the world', with over 26 million players, $16 million in in-app purchases and 1% of it donated to rescue stray cats, and joked that he was waiting for a 'Dogizen'. Binance then picked CATI as its 59th Launchpool project, and the token launched on TON on September 20, 2024.
virality.metrics: Durov's Telegram post (2024-07-23): 14.9M views and about 17K reactions (t.me/s/durov/338, read 2026-09-25). Whitepaper, as of 2024-08-12: 28,539,037 in-game players, 589,784 paying users, 1,730,868 on-chain users, $20.03M cumulative in-game purchases, 5.27M Telegram announcement subscribers. Decrypt (Sep 2024): the game claimed over 34 million users. X @CatizenAI: 2,549,056 followers (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25). CoinGecko: 10,856 watchlist users.

coin.launched: 2024-09-20 (CATI token launch on TON; Binance spot trading from 10:00 UTC; first STON.fi pools 09:47 UTC per DexScreener). The Telegram game itself opened in March 2024.
coin.launchpad: Binance Launchpool (59th project; BNB and FDUSD farming from Sep 16, 2024) plus a player airdrop. Not a memecoin launchpad: CATI is the game's own token, issued by Catizen Limited.
coin.endorsedByOwner: Yes, in the sense that it is the IP holder's own token: the cats are Catizen's game characters, and CATI is issued by Catizen Limited, a subsidiary of the Catizen Foundation Company, with Pluto Studio as developer (Catizen whitepaper).

cats.lore: Catizen began in March 2024 as a tiny cat café inside Telegram. Cartoon cats parachute in, visitors drop by to cuddle them, and whenever two matching cats meet you swipe them together into one bigger, happier cat. Millions of people joined, so many that Telegram's founder, a self-declared dog person, called it the largest cat-lover community in the world. The studio pledged 1% of its revenue to rescuing stray cats, so every café shift helps a real cat somewhere. The orange-and-cream café cat stands in for the whole purring cast.

cats.name: Wiki Cat
cats.whoIsTheCat: No real cat. Wiki Cat is a cartoon mascot, a white cat in round glasses, created by Sir Mapy, a pseudonymous crypto educator in Uyo, Akwa Ibom State, Nigeria, for his SMC DAO community. He renamed his planned 'Mapy Token' to Wiki Cat and launched it on BNB Chain on March 20, 2022 as a 'tutorial token' to teach newcomers about crypto.

virality.summary: Wiki Cat grew through community, not a viral pet. Sir Mapy had gathered about 200 friends in a WhatsApp group, 'Sir Mapy and Co' (SMC), after a 2021 Shiba Inu windfall that a later rug pull wiped out. Out of that setback he launched Wiki Cat on a Sunday in March 2022 with a small BNB pool and one tweet to his roughly 2,800 followers. Technext reports its market value reached $50,000 the same day and $1M within the week. SMC DAO, the community behind it, now calls its members 'Believers', uses the coin for crypto lessons and quizzes, and has built a wallet (Peniwallet) and a remittance app around it.
virality.metrics: Launch announced to about 2,800 X followers (Technext; the project docs say 2,000). Founder-reported peak market cap about $250M and 160,000+ holders (Technext, 2026-04-15), consistent with CoinMarketCap's ATH of $4.728e-7 on 2025-08-20 (about $253M at today's circulating supply). X: @WikiCatCoin 51,945 followers, @sirmapy 90,925, @smcdao 28,846 (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25). CoinGecko: 17,178 watchlist users. Docs claim 50,000+ newcomers onboarded (project claim).

coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable: Wiki Cat is the creator's own cartoon mascot; the coin was launched by its creator, Sir Mapy, for SMC DAO.

cats.lore: Wiki Cat was born in Uyo, Nigeria, after a hard year. Its creator, Sir Mapy, had shared a lucky crypto windfall with a WhatsApp group of friends, then watched it vanish in a rug pull. Instead of quitting, he built something to teach with: on a quiet Sunday in March 2022 he renamed his planned 'Mapy Token' to Wiki Cat and shared it with his followers. The white cat in round glasses became the mascot of SMC DAO, a community of self-styled Believers learning crypto together, and a friendly first lesson for thousands of newcomers.

cats.name: 哈基米 (Hajimi)
cats.catName: 哈基米 (Hajimi): the Chinese internet's word for 'cat'
cats.whoIsTheCat: 哈基米 (hā jī mǐ) is Chinese internet slang for a cat. It comes from 'hachimi' (honey) in Tokai Teio's Honey Song in Uma Musume: Pretty Derby, season 2, episode 12 (2021). Bilibili creator 京桥刹那 remixed the hum on Nov 19, 2022, and in 2023 Douyin users set it to cat videos. The coin's face is an unidentified meme photo of a cream cat with drawn-on blush.

virality.summary: The hum became a cat. In November 2022 Bilibili creator 京桥刹那 retuned Tokai Teio's 'hachimi' hum over CLANNAD's gentle 'Two Fools' (馬鹿ふたり). In 2023 the clip spread to Douyin as background music for countless cat videos, often uncredited, until viewers heard 'ha-ji-mi' as the cat's own name. Anime fans objected, but the cat meaning won; the word then stretched to pandas, robot dogs and anything cute. LIFE WEEK named it one of 2023's top ten memes, 'Hajimi music' mashups became their own genre, and brands raced to use the name. The BNB Chain coin arrived on October 7, 2025, and is now run by its community (a community takeover, or CTO).
virality.metrics: Original remix by 京桥刹那 (Bilibili BV1N14y1p7G3, published 2022-11-19): 3,465,024 views, 209,529 likes, 92,780 favourites, 74,165 coins, 19,216 danmaku (page metadata, read 2026-09-25). BB姬 (2024, cited by Chinese Wikipedia): the meme had 2.5 billion plays on Douyin. One of LIFE WEEK's (三联生活周刊) top ten memes of 2023 (Baidu Baike). Coin: X @hajimi_CTO_BNB 7,967 followers (fxtwitter API, 2026-09-25); 65,054 holders (GeckoTerminal via Phemex, 2026-09-07); Binance Alpha listing on 2025-10-13 and Binance perpetual futures on 2026-09-06 (project site). CoinGecko: 869 watchlist users.

coin.launched: 2025-10-07 (created on four.meme; moved to a PancakeSwap v2 哈基米/WBNB pool at 23:09 UTC per DexScreener; the date matches the project site and Phemex)
coin.endorsedByOwner: No. 哈基米 is a public internet meme with no single owner. No source shows Cygames (Uma Musume), the remix creator 京桥刹那 or the owner of the logo cat endorsing the coin. The project site calls it a decentralized meme token with no team and no roadmap.

cats.lore: Hajimi started as a hum. In an anime about horse girls, Tokai Teio sings a tiny song about honey: 'hachimi'. In November 2022 a Bilibili creator set that hum to a soft CLANNAD tune, and in 2023 it drifted onto Douyin, where people paired it with cat videos until the sound and the cat became one. Now 哈基米 is what millions of Chinese netizens call any cat, and then anything round, soft and a little silly. This card wears the face the community chose: a blushing, grinning cream cat that looks like it is singing along.

cats.name: catwifhat
cats.whoIsTheCat: No identified real cat. catwifhat's mascot is a brown tabby with a white muzzle and chest in a chunky salmon-pink knit beanie: a cat version of dogwifhat's Shiba Inu in a pink knit hat. The Solana coin appeared in December 2023. Its first post (Dec 17, 2023) showed a white fluffy cat in a pirate hat before the tabby became the face.

virality.summary: catwifhat is the cats' reply to dogwifhat: its first post, on December 17, 2023, read '$wif is dog, $cwif is cat, wif a hat!'. It spread less through one viral image than through giveaways. The community airdropped CWIF to about 1.4 million holders of 100+ Solana projects and to NFT communities such as Mad Lads, Okay Bears, Claynosaurz and Saga Genesis, which made it one of the most widely held memecoins on Solana. It also uses Solana Token Extensions to burn 4% of every transfer.
virality.metrics: Holders: 1,480,652 (project API api.cwifstats.com, read 2026-09-25 20:40 UTC). Airdrops to 1.6M+ recipients in total (project docs). X @catwifhatsolana: 81,720 followers; the first post (2023-12-17) had 1,741 views and 38 likes (fxtwitter API). CoinGecko: 193,015 watchlist users.

coin.launched: December 2023: introduced Dec 15, 2023 (project site and CoinMarketCap) on an earlier contract ('CWIFv0'); the current contract's first pool, CWIF/SOL on FluxBeam, opened 2023-12-27 03:54 UTC (DexScreener)
coin.launchpad: None: a Token-2022 mint with a fixed 4% transfer fee and all authorities revoked, traded from a direct FluxBeam pool (locked)
coin.endorsedByOwner: Not applicable / none found: the mascot is a hat-wearing tabby image with no identified real cat or owner. The coin is an unaffiliated parody of dogwifhat.

cats.lore: When a Shiba in a pink knit hat took over Solana, the cats answered in December 2023 with a tabby in a chunky knit beanie of its own: catwifhat. The joke was simple ('wif is dog, cwif is cat'), but the community made it big by giving it away, sending the coin to well over a million wallets across Solana's projects and NFT clubs. Every transfer quietly burns a small slice, so each hop leaves a little less behind. Calm, green-eyed and completely unbothered by the fuss, this is the hattest cat in the garden.
